biggest_catch: This is a prepaid-electricity supplier — the 'credit' is a prepaid-balance credit for a plan that requires upfront payments, and the referred friend must call in and complete an initial payment before you get anything.
catches: Now Power sells prepaid electricity plans: customers pay upfront for power, so the $30 'credit' is a credit to a prepaid account balance, not a discount on an existing bill.
The friend must call 1-844-223-2161 to sign up, provide your account number (or your name and service address), enroll, and make their initial payment — only then is your $30 credit issued.
The $10 second-tier bonus only applies if YOUR referral themselves refers a friend who signs up and pays.
Prepaid plans typically carry higher effective rates and immediate-disconnect risk on non-payment vs postpaid plans — worth weighing before recommending.
Framing: a prepaid-balance credit reduces future electricity cost; you must already be a Now Power customer to earn referrer-side credits.

Share it with a friend or family member.
The friend calls 1-844-223-2161 to sign up for a Now Power prepaid electric plan and provides your account number (or your name and service address).
